# Audio decoders (vendored)

Single-file decoders used by mixd's sampler to read pad files. Compiled in `apps/mixd/src/decoders_impl.cpp`
and `apps/mixd/src/vorbis_impl.cpp` only.

| File | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dr_wav.h` | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | 0.14.6 (master, 2026-10-24) | public domain (Unlicense) or MIT-0 |
| `dr_flac.h` | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | 0.13.4 (master, 2026-10-24) | public domain (Unlicense) or MIT-0 |
| `dr_mp3.h` | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | 0.7.4 (master, 2026-10-24) | public domain (Unlicense) or MIT-0 |
| `stb_vorbis.c` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | 1.22 | public domain or MIT |

Update by downloading the files again from the same repositories.
